System map in Admin → Governance + close 2026-10-17 (#566)

* docs: 2026-10-17 morning routine — queues 0/0, A5 unchanged at 44

Folded curator decisions 0a6cd85e (DEV) + 580122cc (PROD) as one A5 note;
5 security findings suppressed after live re-verification.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh

* fix(governance): MAG Agreement PDF download returned unknown_document

The policy-pdf route kept its own hardcoded allow-list (privacy, terms,
refund-policy). The MAG Agreement was added to CUSTOMER_POLICIES on
2026-09-23, so the hub rendered its Download button but the route
rejected the slug. Derive the allow-list from the same registry.

Test renders every registry slug from the real content file; it fails
on the old route for mag-agreement.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh

* Refiner naming: drop Austrian Mint, use the Terms §3 list everywhere

Customer, agent and outreach copy named the Austrian Mint as an example
refiner although no shop-visible product comes from it. Copy now uses the
Terms §3 list approved in Wave D (PAMP, Valcambi, Nadir, Argor-Heraeus),
held once as REFINER_EXAMPLES in positioning.ts. Guard test
refiner-naming.test.ts fails if a copy source names the Austrian Mint
again. Parsers and competitor matching are untouched (they legitimately
handle other mints).

Route split 195/289/68+7, 171 tables, 7 webhooks (now guarded), MAG in
customer reach, test counts, evening run + delivery windows on Lalamove.

Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh

* Admin payment logos self-hosted (drop Clearbit); system map counts derived; print copy

- Shared PAYMENT_PROVIDER_LOGOS map (src/lib/payments/provider-logos.ts) used by
  checkout and the admin payment-fees panel. Clearbit was CSP-blocked by img-src
  and always fell back to a text chip.
- docs/architecture.html: Clearbit row removed; tile = 38 integrations · 34
  companies, both derived by the drift test from the table (data-company marks
  repeat companies); Machine card cron count 64 -> 67, now guarded.
- docs/print/architecture-2026-10-17.html: light A4 printable snapshot.
- SDUI §209: zero iOS impact.

* docs: shipping minimum-order-value design (draft, decisions pending)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh

* Shipping minimum order value per carrier (web + admin + server gate; native row in iOS 1.0.11)

- shipper_settings.min_order_sgd (migration 20261017, seeds S$150 on lalamove + evening where NULL)
- /api/shipping-options sends minOrderSgd per carrier (additive JSON)
- checkShipperMinOrder re-checks in orders/create, hitpay/create, stripe/create-intent (409, fails open on read error, exempts MAG/vault/gold_yield/self_pickup)
- Web + native picker show a below-minimum carrier greyed with "Minimum order S$X for this option."
- Admin -> Shippers "Minimum order (SGD)" field; PUT allowlist + validation
- Order value = gold + accessories, before discounts, excluding shipping/processing fees
- iOS MARKETING_VERSION 1.0.11; SDUI contract §210

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh

* System map in Admin → Governance + close 2026-10-17

New "System map" tab in Admin → Governance opens
GET /api/admin/governance/architecture, which serves docs/architecture.html
admin-gated (auth before the file read, 30/min, private no-store, no-script
CSP), read live from the repo file. The wrap helper lives in
src/lib/governance/architecture.ts (route files may export only handlers).
docs/architecture.html is now web-relevant in the deploy classifier and
traced into the bundle, so a map-only edit deploys. Route counts in the map
updated for the new route (560 / 290 admin).

CLAUDE.md: closed 2026-10-17 and set the 2026-10-18 agenda.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01WQ4W5Uj5JdM1FD66Bx7WBh
